mentions.name: Votito
mentions.description: Votito is a unified product management service that combines idea banks and feature request boards with product management surveys, helping teams discover actionable signals from the noise of user feedback and follow up with interested users for in-depth research. An early version is live at the provided site.
mentions.problem: User feedback is noisy, making it hard to discover good signals, and teams previously had to combine several separate tools for idea boards and surveys; this unifies everything into a single tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: combining idea banks/feature request boards with popular product management surveys, with the idea to help people discover better signals from the noise of user feedback, and then follow up with interested users for in-depth research.
mentions.author: gojkoa
